title: {session}.json (session manifest)
description: Created by step 2 (create-session.sh). cc_session_id is the Claude Code session id captured at step 2 (entry-flow). pid is the OS process id of the live claude main process (resolved by find-claude-pid.sh - walks up the process tree until comm basename == claude). See apex-core.md Conventions / Session manifest schema.

pid.description: OS pid of the live claude main process owning the session. Resolved at create-session.sh time via find-claude-pid.sh. NEVER set to a transient subshell pid - that would mark the session stale to sibling /apex.

cc_session_id.description: Claude Code session id captured at step 2; never overwritten
